abstract: The International Symposium 'Microbial Growth and Behavior: From Bench to Nature' was held as part of the annual meeting of the Society for Genome Microbiology, Japan. This session was designed to highlight challenges in modern microbiology: how to connect molecular insights obtained from laboratory model systems with the dynamic and complex responses of microbes in natural environments.
